_comment: Which tier each test is reported under, and what each promotion stage runs. scripts/test-tiers.py reads tiers; test/ci (TestTiersPartitionPackages, TestEveryCIJobHasAStage) checks both against the module and the workflows. A test lands in the first tier whose rule matches it: packages is a package pattern (relative to the module, or test/sdk/go; every package when absent), tests a test-name pattern (every test when absent). A rule with tests cuts tests out of whichever tier their package is in; a rule with packages alone is a package tier.

tiers.name: equivalence
tiers._comment: what make equivalence runs of internal/bundled; the rest of it is unit

pull_request.plan: computes the selection: cmd/affected over the files the pull request changes
pull_request.unit: every package, each read from main's result cache unless its inputs changed
pull_request.race: the affected packages whose tests link changed code or whose tests changed, -race -short (internal/racegate skips single-goroutine large-input tests)
pull_request.fuzz: the targets in the packages race takes
pull_request.mutation: every mutant of a changed package or of the packages whose tests import a changed test helper, and those whose entries changed (internal/mutation select_test.go)
pull_request.image: when cmd/mirror, a Dockerfile or a profile changes
pull_request.generated-models: when specs, internal/generated or cmd/mirrorgen change
pull_request.cloudflare-miniflare: when a package the -tags miniflare suite compiles, test/behavior/cloudflare or tools/cloudflare-runtime change
pull_request.test: fails unless every required job passed or was skipped as unaffected

main.unit: every package, writing the result cache pull requests read
main.test: fails unless every required job passed

nightly.report: when a job above fails, adds the run to the one open issue titled nightly failed
